travel.arrival: Reach Mumbai by 11:20 AM, 16 Mar 2026 (09705 BDTS Nonstop SF Exp)

itinerary.title: Board Train from Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Bandra Terminus. Reporting Time: 08:30 AM. Board train for Jaipur. Overnight journey. 12 March 2026 (Thursday)

itinerary.title: Jaipur Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Reach Jaipur by morning. Check in at hotel. Freshen up. After breakfast, proceed for city sightseeing. Visit Hawa Mahal, City Palace, and Jantar Mantar. Dinner and overnight stay. 13 March 2026 (Friday)

itinerary.title: Khatu Shyam Ji Darshan
itinerary.description: Early morning departure from hotel. Proceed to Khatu Shyam Ji darshan (3 hrs). Return to Jaipur by afternoon. Shopping time at local market. Dinner and overnight stay. 14 March 2026 (Saturday)

itinerary.title: Jaipur Sightseeing & Return
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for remaining sightseeing places. Visit Amer Fort and local markets. In the evening, check out from hotel and proceed to railway station. Board train for Mumbai. 15 March 2026 (Sunday)

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Reach Jaipur Junction till 06:00 AM. Board train for Mumbai. Reach Mumbai by 11:20 AM, 16 March 2026. Return home with sweet memories!
